message.content: {"caption":"Flow diagram of the SEAL reinforcement-learning loop for generating and evaluating model self-edits.","description":"A context is processed by a language model with parameters θₜ, which generates three candidate self-edits (SE₁–SE₃). Each edit is used to optimize a loss and produce an updated parameter set. The three resulting models are tested on a downstream task, and their answers receive success or failure marks. The evaluation outcomes are collected as reinforcement-learning data and used to update the policy to θₜ₊₁.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
